description: This file implements a trial comparison certificate verifier with classes for managing verification jobs and requests, including logic for running primary and trial verifications, handling configuration changes, and reporting results.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job
classes.description: Represents a verification job managing primary and trial certificate verification processes, handling callbacks, configuration changes, and result reporting.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request
classes.description: Represents a request object owned by verification callers, coordinating with the Job to handle completion and abortion.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Start
methods.description: Initiates the verification process, starting primary verification and setting up callbacks.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to configuration, marking the job for re-verification if needed.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::DetachRequest
methods.description: Detaches the request from the job, typically when the request is being destroyed.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Finish
methods.description: Completes the job, reports results, and potentially deletes the job.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::FinishSuccess
methods.description: Marks the job as successfully completed.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::FinishWithError
methods.description: Marks the job as failed and reports the error.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnPrimaryJobCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of primary verification, triggers trial verification if applicable.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnTrialJobCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of trial verification, compares results, and determines if re-verification is needed.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnPrimaryReverifyWithSecondaryChainCompleted
methods.description: Handles re-verification with secondary chain and compares results.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request::OnJobComplete
methods.description: Invokes the client callback upon job completion.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request::OnJobAborted
methods.description: Handles job abortion, resetting the callback.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::TrialComparisonCertVerifier
methods.description: Constructor initializing verifiers and setting up observers.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::~TrialComparisonCertVerifier
methods.description: Destructor removing observers.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Verify
methods.description: Main verification method, managing whether to run trial or primary verification based on configuration.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::SetConfig
methods.description: Updates configuration and propagates to underlying verifiers.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to underlying verifiers.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from underlying verifiers.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::UpdateVerifyProcData
methods.description: Updates verification process data and notifies jobs of configuration changes.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::RemoveJob
methods.description: Removes a job from the active jobs set.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::ProcessImplParams
methods.description: Processes implementation parameters for primary and trial verifiers.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::NotifyJobsOfConfigChange
methods.description: Notifies all active jobs of configuration changes.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles external changes to the underlying verifiers.
